newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banque Audi stars on quiet Beirut market.
newsitem.headline: Banque Audi stars on quiet Beirut market.

text.p: Banque Audi continued its rise on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Thursday but Solidere was mixed and other stocks were quiet or inactive.
Audi rose to $17 from $16.625, keeping up a surge that has seen it rise 13 percent since listing on January 20 at $15. Turnover in Audi shares was 46,250 against Wednesday's 50,000.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, the only other bank traded, was steady in slow trade at $12. Some 2,000 shares changed hands compared with 4,000 on Wednesday.
Solidere A fell to $10.5 from $10.75 while B shares rose to $11.25 from $10.875.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Uniceramic and Eternit.
Total turnover was 106,710 shares for a value of $1,445,170 against 72,878 shares for a value of $938,724.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.64 percent to 920.47 and the LISPI stock index rose 0.33 percent to 81.41.
